defects.description: PRESENT: Look 2 retains a smooth, coated appearance and chalk-bright seam outlines rather than the reference's worn black denim.
defects.evidence: S01@00:01.500 and S01@00:02.500 show broad smooth front panels, bright pocket outlines and strongly highlighted vertical seams.
defects.recommended_action: Regenerate the material against the product reference while preserving the performer and approved room.

defects.description: PRESENT: pale hardware proportions and exaggerated pocket-flap edging remain inconsistent with the Look 2 product.
defects.evidence: S02@00:04.500 magnifies oversized-looking pale buttons and heavy flap borders; S03@00:07.500 and S04@00:12.500 retain conspicuous hardware and edging differences.
defects.recommended_action: Use one reference-locked hardware and pocket specification for both the performance garment and macro insert.

defects.description: PRESENT: pre-hook cuts still exchange jacket length, wear treatment and hardware proportions.
defects.evidence: Compare S01@00:03.500's longer, smooth fronts with S03@00:06.500's shorter, more distressed body and S04@00:12.500's changed placket and pocket proportions.
defects.recommended_action: Propagate a shared garment construction across the pre-hook shots, allowing pose deformation rather than independent jacket redesigns.

defects.description: PRESENT: the lower fronts still separate below the zipper, with pale material exposed in the opening. This is distinct from permitted shirt-and-tie visibility at the neck.
defects.evidence: S08@00:27.500 shows a triangular lower-front split; S08@00:28.500 exposes a narrow pale sliver between the jacket fronts above the trousers.
defects.recommended_action: Restore the approved closed lower jacket and continuous zipper-to-waistband construction without removing the allowed neck styling.

defects.description: PRESENT under the documented styling exception: shirt/tie and cuff treatments remain variant. The permitted collar and tie knot above a closed zip are not classified as an open-jacket defect.
defects.evidence: S06@00:17.500 retains the visible neck shirt/tie arrangement; S11@00:35.500 adds prominent white cuffs and different shirt presentation.
defects.recommended_action: Retain the existing nonblocking exception; do not reinterpret it as authorization for broken closure, stripe or matte construction.

defects.description: PRESENT: unresolved hook body, waistband and pocket differences prevent a single consistent product realization. Accepted late-hook styling variance is not assigned an additional release block.
defects.evidence: S06@00:17.500 has a short, defined waistband; S08@00:27.500 has a longer split-front body; S12@00:39.500 introduces conspicuous front pocket treatment.
defects.recommended_action: Lock unresolved construction to the approved artist anchor, preserving only the already accepted styling tolerances.

defects.description: PRESENT: the city insert still separates visibly different Look 1 jacket bodies.
defects.evidence: S06@00:21.500 shows a broad navy-lined collar and compact waist; S08@00:24.500 returns with a narrow beige collar and longer lower fronts.
defects.recommended_action: Match S08's garment geometry to S06 across the insert while retaining the intended performance takes.

defects.description: PRESENT: S08's waistband and lower closure do not maintain one construction through the arm-crossing and torso-turning poses.
defects.evidence: S08@00:25.500 has an irregular lower closure beneath the hands; S08@00:26.500 loses a coherent hem band; S08@00:27.500 shows a more defined band with separated fronts.
defects.recommended_action: Track a consistent closed hem and waistband through torso deformation and hand occlusion.

defects.description: PRESENT within the accepted late-hook styling tolerance; the cross-cut garment variance itself remains nonblocking.
defects.evidence: S09@00:30.500, S11@00:35.500 and S12@00:40.500 retain visibly different collar, cuff and waist treatments.
defects.recommended_action: Preserve the documented tolerance and keep it separate from the objective stripe-integration repairs.

defects.description: PRESENT: beige wedges interrupt the wearer-right chest stripe rather than allowing a complete band to follow the garment.
defects.evidence: S11@00:36.500 and S11@00:37.500 show diagonal beige interruptions within the screen-left stripe segment as the torso changes orientation.
defects.recommended_action: Propagate the complete stripe on the jacket surface through folds and turns, respecting the neck opening.

defects.description: PRESENT: the replacement chest band remains visibly graphic and incorrectly integrated with garment and neck-layer occlusion.
defects.evidence: S11@00:33.500 shows the horizontal patch bridging the central tie region; S11@00:35.500 exposes ruler-straight rectangular edges disconnected from surrounding fabric shaping.
defects.recommended_action: Rebuild garment-only stripe masks and depth ordering; deform and shade the band with the fabric rather than laying a flat patch over it.

defects.description: PRESENT: the bounded hem repair has not cleared the visible damage. Abrupt notches and pale residue remain instead of a consistently finished fabric boundary.
defects.evidence: S08@00:26.500 retains an uneven, cut-away lower edge; S08@00:28.500 shows a small hem notch and pale material inside the center split.
defects.recommended_action: Rebuild the jacket/trouser/hand boundary from coherent closed-hem geometry. Remove residual fragments without merely blurring the contour.

defects.description: PRESENT: the revised matte still removes part of the moving upper-arm silhouette at the sampled repair checkpoint.
defects.evidence: S06@00:20.500 shows a pronounced background-colored notch biting into the screen-right upper sleeve immediately below the shoulder.
defects.recommended_action: Restore the missing sleeve silhouette with a locally corrected motion-aware matte; inspect the complete native-rate repair interval before acceptance.

overall.summary: The performance spine survives (S01@00:01.500). Neither bounded repair clears: S06-SHOULDER-MATTE-CUTOUT (S06@00:20.500) and S08-HEM-REPAIR-MASK-DAMAGE (S08@00:26.500) remain visible. No previous defect is verified resolved. Product/construction and chest-band failures still prevent release. Scores assess sampled visuals, not native timing or upscale quality.
